    session_id = str(ctx.get("session_id", "default"))
    # A half-open window is rejected at the REQUEST ENTRY, before the leg fan
    # (R5): a caller bug must not cost a full tier-1 fan-out first.
    try:
        window = read_window(ctx)
    except WindowError as exc:
        emit([reject_message(exc)])

    if tier in ("1", "2"):
        match = fts_match(query)
        out = []
        if match:
            out.append(store_op({"operation": "search", "table": "episodes",
                                 "columns": ["id", "session_id", "content", "recorded_at",
                                             "channel", "audience_set"],
                                 "match": match, "limit": LEG_LIMIT}, "t1-kw-ep"))
            out.append(store_op({"operation": "search", "table": "facts",
                                 "columns": ["id", "episode_id", "subject", "claim",
                                             "valid_from", "expired_at",
                                             "channel", "audience_set"],
                                 "match": match, "limit": LEG_LIMIT}, "t1-kw-fact"))
        else:
            # No usable query tokens: both keyword legs are empty, and the graph
            # leg has no anchors either. Empty legs, never a missing gate.
            out.append(scratch_insert("kw-ep", []))
            out.append(scratch_insert("kw-fact", []))
            out.append(scratch_insert("graph", []))
        if window is None:
            out.append(store_op({"operation": "select", "table": "facts",
                                 "columns": ["id", "episode_id", "subject", "predicate", "claim",
                                             "fact_kind", "valid_from", "valid_until",
                                             "recorded_at", "channel", "audience_set"],
                                 # R1 in one line, point mode too: the cache column
                                 # is not consulted. It used to be filtered here, which
                                 # stayed invisible while the dream lane wrote nothing --
                                 # with P15 task 7 it made the leg (and the RRF score)
                                 # depend on whether the dream had already run.
                                 "where": {"valid_from": {"lte": as_of},
                                           "valid_until": {"or_null": {"gt": as_of}}},
                                 "order_by": [{"col": "recorded_at", "dir": "desc"},
                                              {"col": "id", "dir": "asc"}],
                                 "limit": LEG_LIMIT}, "t1-temporal"))
        else:
            # Window mode (R5). The pre-filter is GENEROUS on purpose: it may
            # return too much, never too little, because the store cannot know
            # effective_until. The exact cut runs in code (window_hits).
            # expired_at does NOT appear in the where clause -- that is R1 in one
            # line: the chain is the truth, the cache column is not consulted.
            out.append(store_op({"operation": "select", "table": "facts",
                                 "columns": ["id", "subject", "canonical_subject", "predicate",
                                             "canonical_predicate", "claim", "canonical_claim",
                                             "valid_from", "valid_until", "recorded_at",
                                             "expired_at", "superseded_by", "episode_id",
                                             "session_id", "fact_kind", "confidence",
                                             "channel", "audience_set"],
                                 "where": {"valid_from": {"lte": window[1]},
                                           "valid_until": {"or_null": {"gt": window[0]}}},
                                 "order_by": [{"col": "valid_from", "dir": "asc"},
                                              {"col": "recorded_at", "dir": "asc"},
                                              {"col": "id", "dir": "asc"}],
                                 "limit": AXIS_LIMIT}, "t1-temporal"))
        out.append(store_op({"operation": "select", "table": "emb_models",
                             "columns": ["model_id", "dim", "active"],
                             "where": {"active": 1}}, "t1-model"))
        if tier == "2":
            out.append(store_op({"operation": "select", "table": "beliefs",
                                 "columns": ["id", "holder", "statement", "confidence",
                                             "active", "updated_at", "audience_set"],
                                 "where": {"holder": holder_of(), "active": 1},
                                 "order_by": [{"col": "updated_at", "dir": "desc"},
                                              {"col": "id", "dir": "asc"}],
                                 "limit": MAX_BELIEFS}, "t1-beliefs"))
        out.append({"header": {"route": "embed", "phase": "embed-query", "recall_id": rid},
                    "messages": [{"origin": "assistant", "type": "tool_call", "id": "r-embq",
                                  "text": json.dumps({"query": {"text": query,
                                                                "recall_id": rid}})}]})
        emit(out)

    out = [
        store_op({"operation": "select", "table": "episodes",
                  "columns": ["id", "session_id", "sender", "content", "happened_at",
                              "recorded_at", "channel", "audience_set"],
                  "where": {"session_id": session_id},
                  "order_by": [{"col": "recorded_at", "dir": "desc"}, {"col": "id", "dir": "asc"}],
                  "limit": MAX_EPISODES}, "leg-episodes"),
        store_op({"operation": "select", "table": "beliefs",
                  "columns": ["id", "holder", "statement", "confidence", "active",
                              "updated_at", "audience_set"],
                  "where": {"holder": holder_of(), "active": 1},
                  "order_by": [{"col": "updated_at", "dir": "desc"}, {"col": "id", "dir": "asc"}],
                  "limit": MAX_BELIEFS}, "leg-beliefs"),
        store_op({"operation": "select", "table": "facts",
                  "columns": ["id", "subject", "canonical_subject", "predicate",
                              "canonical_predicate", "claim", "fact_kind", "valid_from",
                              "valid_until", "expired_at", "confidence",
                              "channel", "audience_set"],
                  "where": {"fact_kind": "foresight",
                            "expired_at": {"is_null": True},
                            "valid_until": {"or_null": {"gt": as_of}}},
                  "order_by": [{"col": "valid_from", "dir": "asc"}, {"col": "id", "dir": "asc"}],
                  "limit": MAX_FORESIGHT}, "leg-foresight"),
    ]
    emit(out)

# ============================================================ TIER 0 legs
if phase in LEGS:
    rows = rows_of(d)
    # The gate runs here -- before each leg's own cap and long before the token
    # budget in the `fire` phase. All three tier-0 legs pass through it: episodes
    # and foresight facts carry channel + audience_set, a belief carries the set
    # alone (contract, Nachtrag 1). A hidden row must not take a slot, and it
    # must not take a byte.
    #
    # R7 (Nachtrag 3): which AXES lost a version to the gate is recorded in the
    # same pass, because this is the only moment both halves are in hand. Used by
    # the foresight leg below; an episode and a belief have no version chain, so
    # for those the set is collected and never read.
    kept, lost_axes = [], set()
    for r in rows:
        if not isinstance(r, dict):
            continue
        if visible_row(r):
            kept.append(r)
        else:
            lost_axes.add((subject_key(r), axis_key(r)))
    rows = kept
    if phase == "leg-episodes":
        rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: str(r.get("recorded_at", "")), reverse=True)[:MAX_EPISODES]
        payload = [{"id": r.get("id"), "sender": r.get("sender"),
                    "content": trunc(r.get("content"), EPISODE_CHARS),
                    "happened_at": r.get("happened_at")} for r in rows]
    elif phase == "leg-beliefs":
        rows = [r for r in rows if int(r.get("active", 0) or 0) == 1]
        rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: str(r.get("updated_at", "")), reverse=True)[:MAX_BELIEFS]
        payload = [{"id": r.get("id"), "statement": r.get("statement"),
                    "confidence": r.get("confidence")} for r in rows]
    else:
        rows = [r for r in rows if is_open(r.get("expired_at"))]
        rows = [r for r in rows if is_open(r.get("valid_until")) or str(r.get("valid_until")) > as_of]
        rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: str(r.get("valid_from", "")))[:MAX_FORESIGHT]
        payload = [{"id": r.get("id"), "subject": r.get("subject"), "predicate": r.get("predicate"),
                    "claim": r.get("claim"), "valid_from": r.get("valid_from")} for r in rows]
        # R7: a survivor whose axis lost a version this round may not see cannot
        # be vouched for as current. ONE boolean -- never how many were removed,
        # never when, never from which room; that would rebuild the side channel
        # the filter-first order exists to close. Absent unless true, so an
        # unaffected bundle stays byte-identical.
        for item, r in zip(payload, rows):
            if (subject_key(r), axis_key(r)) in lost_axes:
                item["supersession_unknown"] = True
    ins = {"operation": "insert", "table": "recall_scratch",
           "row": {"request_id": rid, "leg": phase, "payload": json.dumps(payload),
                   "created_at": now, "fired": 0}}
    emit([store_op(ins, "collect")])

if phase == "collect" and op == "insert":
    emit([scratch_select("gate")])

if phase == "gate" and op == "select":
    legs = {r.get("leg") for r in rows_of(d)}
    if not set(LEGS) <= legs:
        park()
    emit([store_op({"operation": "update", "table": "recall_scratch", "set": {"fired": 1},
                    "where": {"request_id": rid, "fired": 0}}, "fire-guard")])

if phase == "fire-guard" and op == "update":
    if rows_affected < 1:
        park()
    emit([scratch_select("fire")])

if phase == "fire" and op == "select":
    legs = by_leg(d)
    bundle = {"query": query, "tier": 0, "beliefs": [], "foresight": [], "episodes": []}
    # #16: tier 0 has FIXED legs and no temporal leg, so a COMPLETE window cannot
    # be honoured here -- but it is not dropped in silence either. The smallest
    # honest form (roadmap ruling): the bundle SAYS which range it ignored, in the
    # JSON, in the text the model reads and on the hop for a router. Deliberately
    # NOT a reject (that breaks callers who send the keys on every hop, see the
    # port contract) and NOT an auto-upgrade to tier 1 (that changes the cost of a
    # request without announcing it). A HALF window never reaches this phase --
    # it left through the reject port at request entry (R5).
    window = read_window(ctx)
    if window is not None:
        bundle["window_ignored"] = {"from": window[0], "until": window[1]}
    # #88: the guard's verdict travels with the bundle, never silently. Tier 0
    # does not read the query at all -- but it SHOWS it, so a clamped query
    # without its verdict would be an unexplained difference from what the
    # caller sent. Absent for a healthy query, so that bundle is byte-identical.
    if query_hygiene is not None:
        bundle["query_hygiene"] = query_hygiene
    spent = 0
    # Fixed priority: beliefs -> open foresight -> recent episodes. Deterministic.
    for key, leg in (("beliefs", "leg-beliefs"), ("foresight", "leg-foresight"),
                     ("episodes", "leg-episodes")):
        for item in legs.get(leg, []):
            cost = len(json.dumps(item, sort_keys=True)) // 4 + 1
            if spent + cost > TOKEN_BUDGET:
                break
            bundle[key].append(item)
            spent += cost
    bundle["token_estimate"] = spent
    lines = ["MEMORY (tier 0, deterministic bundle)"]
    if window is not None:
        lines.append("- window_ignored: %s -> %s (tier 0 has fixed legs and no "
                     "temporal leg to cut; ask tier 1 or 2 for a time range)"
                     % (window[0], window[1]))
    for b in bundle["beliefs"]:
        lines.append("- belief: " + str(b.get("statement", "")))
    for f in bundle["foresight"]:
        line = "- open: " + str(f.get("claim", ""))
        # R7 (Nachtrag 3): tier 0 asserts no currency for a marked candidate
        # either. Same wording as the tier-1 line, so one bundle cannot mean
        # something else than the other.
        if f.get("supersession_unknown"):
            line += " (currency unknown: cannot vouch that this still holds)"
        lines.append(line)
    for e in bundle["episodes"]:
        lines.append("- " + str(e.get("sender", "")) + ": " + str(e.get("content", "")))
    header = {"route": "bundle", "recall_id": rid}
    if tier not in ("0", ""):
        header["tier_downgraded"] = "1"
    if window is not None:
        header["window_ignored"] = "1"
    if query_hygiene is not None:
        header["query_hygiene"] = query_hygiene["step"]
    emit([{"header": header,
           "system": {"memory": {"bundle": {"text": json.dumps(bundle, sort_keys=True)}}},
           "messages": [{"origin": "tool", "type": "tool_result", "id": "recall",
                         "text": "\n".join(lines)}]}])

# ============================================================ TIER 1 legs
if phase == "t1-kw-ep":
    # Gated where the rows arrive, so the leg's rank list never contains a hit
    # nobody in this round may see -- ranks are RRF votes.
    rows = visible_rows(rows_of(d))
    payload = [{"kind": "episode", "id": r.get("id")} for r in rows if r.get("id")]
    emit([scratch_insert("kw-ep", payload)])

if phase == "t1-kw-fact":
    # Gated BEFORE the anchors are read off the rows below: an invisible fact
    # must not seed the graph leg either, or the gate would leak through the
    # entity names it hands on.
    rows = visible_rows(rows_of(d))
    payload = [{"kind": "fact", "id": r.get("id")} for r in rows if r.get("id")]
    # Graph anchors, LLM-free: query tokens (case variants, because `in` is exact)
    # plus the local parts of the subjects the keyword leg just found.
    names = set()
    for t in tokens_of(query):
        names.update([t, t.lower(), t.capitalize()])
    for r in rows[:LEG_LIMIT]:
        s = str(r.get("subject") or "")
        local = s.split(":")[-1]
        if local:
            names.update([local, local.lower(), local.capitalize()])
    anchors = sorted(n for n in names if n)
    out = [scratch_insert("kw-fact", payload)]
    if anchors:
        out.append(store_op({"operation": "select", "table": "entities",
                             "columns": ["id", "canonical_name"],
                             "where": {"canonical_name": {"in": anchors[:64]}}}, "t1-anchor"))
    else:
        out.append(scratch_insert("graph", []))
    emit(out)

if phase == "t1-temporal":
    # Gated BEFORE the temporal cut, not instead of it: the audience rule is an
    # ADDITIONAL predicate, and `window_hits` still decides the span exactly as
    # before -- it just never sees a version this round was not present for, so
    # a hidden claim cannot shape the span of a visible one either.
    rows = visible_rows(rows_of(d))
    window = read_window(ctx)
    if window is None:
        rows = [r for r in rows
                if is_open(r.get("valid_until")) or str(r.get("valid_until")) > as_of]
    else:
        rows = window_hits(rows, window[0], window[1])
        # (valid_from desc, recorded_at desc, id asc): newest validity first, the
        # tie-break complete. Two stable passes, because a single reverse=True
        # would flip the id tie-break with the rest of the key.
        rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: str(r.get("id") or ""))
        rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (str(r.get("valid_from") or ""),
                                           str(r.get("recorded_at") or "")), reverse=True)
    payload = [{"kind": "fact", "id": r.get("id")} for r in rows if r.get("id")]
    emit([scratch_insert("temporal", payload)])

if phase == "t1-beliefs":
    # A belief is derived knowledge: its audience_set is the INTERSECTION of the
    # sets of the facts it rests on (contract, Nachtrag 1), written that way by
    # the dreamer. Here it is read like any other tagged row -- with no channel,
    # so the open-history clause cannot reach it.
    rows = [r for r in visible_rows(rows_of(d)) if int(r.get("active", 0) or 0) == 1]
    payload = [{"id": r.get("id"), "statement": r.get("statement"),
                "confidence": r.get("confidence")} for r in rows]
    emit([scratch_insert("beliefs", payload)])

if phase == "t1-anchor":
    names = sorted({str(r.get("canonical_name")) for r in rows_of(d) if r.get("canonical_name")})
    if not names:
        emit([scratch_insert("graph", [])])
    emit([store_op({"operation": "traverse", "table": "entity_edges",
                    "src": "src_entity", "dst": "dst_entity", "kind": "edge_kind",
                    "weight": "weight",
                    "columns": ["episode_id", "channel", "audience_set"],
                    "start": names[:32], "where": {"valid_until": {"is_null": True}},
                    "max_depth": GRAPH_DEPTH, "max_nodes": GRAPH_NODES}, "t1-graph")])

if phase == "t1-graph":
    p = payload_of(d)
    paths = (p or {}).get("paths", []) if isinstance(p, dict) else []
    # The gate ON THE EDGE (contract, Nachtrag 1). `entity_edges` inherit channel
    # and audience_set from the episode they were extracted from, and `traverse`
    # projects the attributes of the LAST edge of each path -- which is exactly
    # the edge whose episode_id becomes the candidate below. So the graph leg
    # gates its own rows here, before its ranking and therefore before fusion.
    # A depth-0 anchor row carries NULL attributes, reads as the empty set and
    # drops out; it carries no episode_id either, so nothing is lost.
    paths = [r for r in paths
             if isinstance(r, dict) and visible_row(r.get("edge") or {})]
    # Rank by (depth asc, weight_sum desc, node asc); the graph leg contributes
    # EPISODES, because entity_edges carries episode_id as its provenance and
    # the node names live in a different namespace than facts.subject.
    paths = sorted(paths, key=lambda r: (int(r.get("depth", 99) or 99),
                                         -int(r.get("weight_sum", 0) or 0),
                                         str(r.get("node", ""))))
    seen, payload = set(), []
    for r in paths:
        eid = (r.get("edge") or {}).get("episode_id")
        if eid and eid not in seen:
            seen.add(eid)
            payload.append({"kind": "episode", "id": eid})
    emit([scratch_insert("graph", payload[:LEG_LIMIT])])

# ------------------------------------------------- semantic join (model+qvec)
if phase == "t1-model":
    rows = rows_of(d)
    row = rows[0] if rows else {}
    emit([scratch_insert("model", {"model_id": row.get("model_id"), "dim": row.get("dim")},
                         "t1-semjoin")])

if phase == "t1-qvec":
    p = payload_of(d) or {}
    # The REASON travels with the verdict (GH #146). The embed cell states why
    # it gave up (timeout, HTTP status, exhausted retries); dropping it here
    # left the warn line below guessing "no query vector" for every cause
    # there is, which is the one thing an operator cannot act on.
    emit([scratch_insert("qvec", {"vector": p.get("vector"),
                                  "degraded": bool(p.get("degraded")),
                                  "error": p.get("error")}, "t1-semjoin")])

if phase == "t1-semjoin" and op == "insert":
    emit([scratch_select("t1-semgate", ["model", "qvec"])])

if phase == "t1-semgate" and op == "select":
    legs = by_leg(d)
    if "model" not in legs or "qvec" not in legs:
        park()
    emit([scratch_guard("qvec", "t1-semguard")])

if phase == "t1-semguard" and op == "update":
    if rows_affected < 1:
        park()
    emit([scratch_select("t1-semfire", ["model", "qvec"])])

if phase == "t1-semfire" and op == "select":
    legs = by_leg(d)
    qvec = legs.get("qvec") or {}
    model = legs.get("model") or {}
    vector = qvec.get("vector")
    model_id = model.get("model_id")
    # CROSS-MODEL INVARIANT: similar is never called without the active model_id
    # from emb_models. No active generation (or no query vector) means an EMPTY
    # semantic leg — never an unfiltered ranking across embedding generations.
    if qvec.get("degraded") or not vector or not model_id:
        # Loud, not silent (GH #144): this is the ONE place that knows the fan
        # is about to run on three legs, and until now it said so only inside
        # the answer body. A line on stderr of an otherwise successful run is
        # what the substrate turns into a warn row in log.jsonl -- so a dead
        # embedder is greppable in the colony log instead of visible only to
        # whoever reads `semantic_degraded` off the answer.
        sys.stderr.write("recall: semantic leg skipped, fusing three legs — %s\n" % (
            qvec.get("error") or ("no query vector" if not vector
                                  else "no active embedding model")))
        emit([scratch_insert("sem", []), scratch_insert("sem-aud", [])])
    emit([store_op({"operation": "similar", "table": "embeddings",
                    "columns": ["owner_id", "model_id", "owner_table"],
                    "vector_column": "blob", "vector": vector,
                    "where": {"model_id": model_id, "status": "ready", "owner_table": "facts"},
                    "limit": LEG_LIMIT}, "t1-sem")])

if phase == "t1-sem":
    rows = rows_of(d)
    payload = [{"kind": "fact", "id": r.get("owner_id")} for r in rows if r.get("owner_id")]
    # The ONE leg whose rows are not the tagged rows themselves: `similar` ranks
    # EMBEDDINGS, and the embeddings table carries no participant set -- the
    # contract tags four kinds and this is not one of them. So the audience of
    # the OWNING facts is fetched as its own scratch leg, in parallel, and the
    # gate waits for it (T1_REQUIRED). The filter then runs in `t1-fuse`, still
    # before the RRF sum. The leg keeps its ranking untouched: the companion only
    # says which of its ids may be counted, never in which order.
    ids = [c["id"] for c in payload]
    out = [scratch_insert("sem", payload)]
    if ids:
        out.append(store_op({"operation": "select", "table": "facts",
                             "columns": ["id", "channel", "audience_set"],
                             "where": {"id": {"in": ids}},
                             "limit": LEG_LIMIT}, "t1-sem-aud"))
    else:
        out.append(scratch_insert("sem-aud", []))
    emit(out)

if phase == "t1-sem-aud":
    emit([scratch_insert("sem-aud", rows_of(d))])

# ------------------------------------------------------------- main fan-in
if phase == "t1-collect" and op == "insert":
    emit([scratch_select("t1-gate")])

if phase == "t1-gate" and op == "select":
    legs = by_leg(d)
    required = set(T1_REQUIRED) | ({"beliefs"} if tier == "2" else set())
    if not required <= set(legs):
        park()
    emit([scratch_guard("kw-ep", "t1-fireguard")])

if phase == "t1-fireguard" and op == "update":
    if rows_affected < 1:
        park()
    emit([scratch_select("t1-fuse")])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- RRF fusion
if phase == "t1-fuse" and op == "select":
    legs = by_leg(d)
    # keyword is ONE leg: the two searches are merged deterministically by their
    # own rank, facts before episodes on a tie.
    kw = []
    ep_list, fact_list = legs.get("kw-ep", []), legs.get("kw-fact", [])
    for i in range(max(len(ep_list), len(fact_list))):
        if i < len(fact_list):
            kw.append(fact_list[i])
        if i < len(ep_list):
            kw.append(ep_list[i])
    # The semantic leg is gated HERE, because it is the only leg that cannot gate
    # itself (see t1-sem): `sem-aud` carries channel + audience_set of the facts
    # its embeddings belong to. Membership only -- the surviving ids keep the
    # leg's own order, so the gate removes votes and never reorders them. An id
    # with no companion row reads as the empty set and drops: fail-closed. Every
    # other leg arrives already gated, so nothing hidden enters the sum below.
    sem_aud = {str(r.get("id")): r for r in (legs.get("sem-aud") or [])
               if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("id")}
    sem = [c for c in (legs.get("sem") or [])
           if visible_row(sem_aud.get(str(c.get("id"))) or {})]
    lists = {"keyword": kw, "semantic": sem,
             "graph": legs.get("graph", []), "temporal": legs.get("temporal", [])}

    # O-4: point mode fuses WITHOUT the temporal vote, window mode with it. The leg
    # ran either way -- the cut it performed is already inside `lists`.
    ranked, scores, hit_legs = fuse_rank(lists, fusion_weights(ctx))
    fused = {"candidates": [{"kind": k[0], "id": k[1], "score": round(scores[k], 8),
                             "legs": hit_legs[k]} for k in ranked],
             # Leg attribution is a first-class output: the eval report has to be
             # able to say which leg carried a hit, and an empty leg must be
             # visible as empty rather than as absent.
             "legs_present": [n for n in LEG_ORDER if lists.get(n)],
             "leg_sizes": {n: len(lists.get(n) or []) for n in LEG_ORDER},
             "semantic_degraded": not lists.get("semantic")}
    # The fused ranking AND both hydration selects go out together — the ids are
    # in hand right here, so no extra round trip is needed to read them back.
    fact_ids = [c["id"] for c in fused["candidates"] if c["kind"] == "fact"]
    ep_ids = [c["id"] for c in fused["candidates"] if c["kind"] == "episode"]
    out = [scratch_insert("fused", fused, "t1-noop")]
    if fact_ids:
        # No expired_at filter any more (R1/R4): supersession is DERIVED from the
        # version chain at read time, so a superseded hit is not dropped here --
        # t1-emit projects it onto its successor. A candidate without a hydration
        # row is still dropped there.
        out.append(store_op({"operation": "select", "table": "facts",
                             "columns": ["id", "episode_id", "subject", "canonical_subject",
                                         "predicate", "canonical_predicate", "claim",
                                         "fact_kind", "valid_from", "valid_until",
                                         "expired_at", "superseded_by", "confidence",
                                         "channel", "audience_set"],
                             "where": {"id": {"in": fact_ids}}}, "t1-hyd-fact"))
    else:
        out.append(scratch_insert("hyd-fact", [], "t1-hcollect"))
        out.append(scratch_insert("hyd-axis", [], "t1-hcollect"))
        out.append(scratch_insert("card", {}, "t1-hcollect"))
    if ep_ids:
        out.append(store_op({"operation": "select", "table": "episodes",
                             "columns": ["id", "session_id", "sender", "content",
                                         "happened_at", "recorded_at",
                                         "channel", "audience_set"],
                             "where": {"id": {"in": ep_ids}}}, "t1-hyd-ep"))
    else:
        out.append(scratch_insert("hyd-ep", [], "t1-hcollect"))
    emit(out)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ hydration
if phase == "t1-hyd-fact":
    # Residual guard: these ids come from an already gated ranking, so this drops
    # nothing in a healthy run -- and a candidate without a hydration row is
    # dropped in t1-emit, which makes the guard cost one comparison and close the
    # path anyway if a leg ever forgets its gate.
    rows = visible_rows(rows_of(d))
    out = [scratch_insert("hyd-fact", rows, "t1-hcollect")]
    # R3: ONE additional select carries every axis of every fact hit. The store
    # has no GROUP BY and answers one result set per message, so a select per
    # candidate would be up to LEG_LIMIT extra round trips. The `in` cross
    # product can return axes nobody asked for -- project_fact_candidate matches
    # on the PAIR, so those are dropped in code.
    subjects = sorted({subject_key(r) for r in rows if subject_key(r)})
    predicates = sorted({axis_key(r) for r in rows if axis_key(r)})
    if subjects and predicates:
        out.append(store_op({"operation": "select", "table": "facts",
                             "columns": ["id", "subject", "canonical_subject", "predicate",
                                         "canonical_predicate", "claim", "canonical_claim",
                                         "valid_from", "valid_until", "recorded_at",
                                         "expired_at", "superseded_by", "episode_id",
                                         "session_id", "fact_kind", "confidence",
                                         "channel", "audience_set"],
                             "where": {"canonical_subject": {"in": subjects},
                                       "canonical_predicate": {"in": predicates}},
                             "order_by": [{"col": "valid_from", "dir": "asc"},
                                          {"col": "recorded_at", "dir": "asc"},
                                          {"col": "id", "dir": "asc"}],
                             "limit": AXIS_LIMIT}, "t1-hyd-axis"))
        # W5 (#13, ruling Q3): the judged cardinality of exactly these relations,
        # fired WITH the axis page rather than after it. Both are answers this
        # request needs before it can project a hit, and both land in the fan-in
        # the emit gate already waits for -- so the verdict costs an op, never a
        # hop, on the lane that runs while somebody is waiting.
        out.append(store_op({"operation": "select", "table": "predicate_cardinality",
                             "columns": ["canonical_predicate", "verdict"],
                             "where": {"canonical_predicate": {"in": predicates}}},
                            "t1-hyd-card"))
    else:
        out.append(scratch_insert("hyd-axis", [], "t1-hcollect"))
        out.append(scratch_insert("card", {}, "t1-hcollect"))
    emit(out)

if phase == "t1-hyd-axis":
    # NOT a residual guard (R8, Nachtrag 3) -- this is a real hole otherwise. The
    # axis page is a CROSS PRODUCT over canonical subject x predicate: it
    # deliberately returns facts no leg ever hit, and `project_fact_candidate`
    # projects a superseded candidate onto its SUCCESSOR out of exactly these
    # rows. An ungated axis would therefore render a claim this round may not
    # see, through a candidate it may.
    #
    # R7 (Nachtrag 3): and this is where the chain BREAKS. Removing a version
    # before the chain is built is the right order -- the other way round the
    # existence of an invisible version would show through the validity span,
    # and asking often enough maps out when something was said in a room one is
    # not in. But the price must not be paid silently: without the mark below a
    # claim whose successor is invisible renders as current, and the agent
    # answers wrong. So the surviving rows of a broken axis carry one boolean.
    rows, lost_axes = [], set()
    for r in rows_of(d):
        if not isinstance(r, dict):
            continue
        if visible_row(r):
            rows.append(r)
        else:
            lost_axes.add((subject_key(r), axis_key(r)))
    for r in rows:
        if (subject_key(r), axis_key(r)) in lost_axes:
            # The flag rides on the ROW so that it survives the scratch round
            # trip and reaches every consumer of the axis page at once
            # (project_fact_candidate, fact_span, superseded_marker). It is read
            # off the axis leg in t1-emit and never copied into the bundle from
            # here -- a candidate gets it because its AXIS is marked, not because
            # some row it was built from happened to carry a key.
            r["supersession_unknown"] = True
    emit([scratch_insert("hyd-axis", rows, "t1-hcollect")])

if phase == "t1-hyd-card":
    # The MAP the projection consumes, not the rows: one shape, derived once, so
    # the read path cannot disagree with itself between two requests. A store too
    # old to carry the table answers with an error outcome and the map is empty,
    # which is the pre-W5 behaviour exactly.
    judged = {}
    for r in rows_of(d):
        key = str(r.get("canonical_predicate") or "")
        verdict = str(r.get("verdict") or "")
        if key and verdict in ("single", "multi"):
            judged[key] = verdict
    emit([scratch_insert("card", judged, "t1-hcollect")])

if phase == "t1-hyd-ep":
    # Residual guard, same argument as hyd-fact above.
    rows = visible_rows(rows_of(d))
    emit([scratch_insert("hyd-ep", rows, "t1-hcollect")])

if phase == "t1-hcollect" and op == "insert":
    emit([scratch_select("t1-hgate",
                         ["fused", "hyd-fact", "hyd-ep", "hyd-axis", "card", "beliefs"])])

if phase == "t1-hgate" and op == "select":
    legs = by_leg(d)
    if "hyd-fact" not in legs or "hyd-ep" not in legs or "hyd-axis" not in legs:
        park()
    if "card" not in legs:
        park()
    emit([scratch_guard("fused", "t1-hguard")])

if phase == "t1-hguard" and op == "update":
    if rows_affected < 1:
        park()
    emit([scratch_select("t1-emit",
                         ["fused", "hyd-fact", "hyd-ep", "hyd-axis", "card", "beliefs"])])

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- emit / t2
if phase in ("t1-emit", "t2-downgrade") and op == "select":
    legs = by_leg(d)
    facts = {str(r.get("id")): r for r in (legs.get("hyd-fact") or [])}
    episodes = {str(r.get("id")): r for r in (legs.get("hyd-ep") or [])}
    # The axis rows are trimmed to the read instant BEFORE the chain is built:
    # "current" means current AS OF the request (spec D.5), never "newest on
    # disk" -- otherwise a question about the past would be answered with a fact
    # that was not written yet at that time.
    axis_rows = [r for r in (legs.get("hyd-axis") or [])
                 if str(r.get("valid_from") or "") <= as_of]
    # R7 (Nachtrag 3): the axes whose version chain lost a row to the gate. Read
    # from the UNTRIMMED leg on purpose -- a version newer than the read instant
    # is trimmed out one line above, and a version newer than the read instant is
    # exactly the kind that makes a survivor's currency unvouchable.
    unknown_axes = {(subject_key(r), axis_key(r))
                    for r in (legs.get("hyd-axis") or [])
                    if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("supersession_unknown")}
    # W5 (#13, ruling Q3): the store's judged cardinality, one map from relation
    # to verdict. A bundle whose leg is empty reads exactly as it read before --
    # the seed list and the session-guarded rule are still underneath.
    judged = legs.get("card") or {}
    if not isinstance(judged, dict):
        judged = {}
    fused = legs.get("fused") or {}
    # The window is read again here rather than carried on the leg payload: the
    # context slot is persistent, so every phase of one request sees the same
    # answer, and the fused ranking keeps its shape (kind, id, score, legs).
    window = read_window(ctx)
    # seen_facts maps a projected fact id onto the SLOT its survivor occupies, so a
    # later hit on the same axis can still hand over its legs (O-4b).
    candidates, spent, seen_facts, win_ord = [], 0, {}, {}
    # #15: seen_eps maps the NORMAL FORM of an episode onto the slot its line
    # occupies, ep_newest onto the recency of the copy currently rendered there.
    seen_eps, ep_newest = {}, {}
    for c in fused.get("candidates") or []:
        row = facts.get(str(c["id"])) if c["kind"] == "fact" else episodes.get(str(c["id"]))
        if row is None:
            continue
        ord_key = None
        if c["kind"] == "fact":
            # R4: in a POINT query the candidate is the CURRENT fact of the
            # hit's axis; a superseded hit turns into a history entry on its
            # successor. A WINDOW query does NOT collapse: R4 exists so that a
            # superseded claim never looks like the truth in force, and in an
            # explicit time-range question the versions themselves are the
            # answer -- each carrying the span it was valid for. The fallback
            # keeps a candidate WITHOUT history rather than losing it when the
            # axis select was truncated or carried no matching pair.
            if window is None:
                row = project_fact_candidate(str(c["id"]), axis_rows, judged) or dict(
                    row, history=[])
            else:
                row = fact_span(str(c["id"]), axis_rows) or dict(
                    row, history=[],
                    span={"from": row.get("valid_from"), "until": row.get("valid_until")})
            # Two hits on one axis collapse into one candidate. First wins: the
            # fusion order is already total (score, best_rank, leg, kind, id),
            # so which hit survives is deterministic.
            if str(row.get("id")) in seen_facts:
                # O-4b: the hit is dropped, its ATTRIBUTION is not.
                merge_legs(candidates[seen_facts[str(row.get("id"))]], c["legs"])
                continue
            # The slot this candidate will occupy once it clears the budget check --
            # same idiom as win_ord below. A candidate that breaks the budget ends the
            # loop, so the recorded slot is never read without being filled.
            seen_facts[str(row.get("id"))] = len(candidates)
            if window is not None:
                ord_key = ((row.get("valid_from") or ""),
                           (row.get("recorded_at") or ""),
                           str(row.get("id") or ""))
        else:
            # #15: a question asked five times is ONE line with a count, not five
            # slots holding one string. Same first-winner semantics as the axis
            # collapse above -- the best-ranked copy owns the slot and collects the
            # legs of the copies that fold into it (O-4b) -- and the same
            # PRESENTATION-only scope: no row is touched, level 0 stays
            # append-only, the collapse lives in the bundle and nowhere else. An
            # empty normal form is no identity at all, so it never collapses.
            key = normalize_text(row.get("content"))
            slot = seen_eps.get(key) if key else None
            if slot is not None:
                merge_legs(candidates[slot], c["legs"])
                candidates[slot]["seen"] += 1
                if episode_ord(row) > ep_newest[key]:
                    ep_newest[key] = episode_ord(row)
                    adopt_episode(candidates[slot], c["id"], row)
                continue
            if key:
                # The slot this line will occupy once it clears the budget check --
                # same idiom as seen_facts above.
                seen_eps[key] = len(candidates)
                ep_newest[key] = episode_ord(row)
        item = {"rank": len(candidates) + 1, "kind": c["kind"], "id": c["id"],
                "score": c["score"], "legs": c["legs"]}
        if c["kind"] == "fact":
            item["id"] = row.get("id")
            item["history"] = row.get("history") or []
            # W1 (ruling Q6). The key is absent when nothing closed the
            # statement, so only a superseded candidate pays a byte of budget for
            # it, and the ranking is untouched -- the demotion of closed
            # statements is its own package.
            marker = superseded_marker(row, axis_rows, as_of)
            if marker is not None:
                item["superseded"] = trunc(marker, T1_ITEM_CHARS)
            if window is not None:
                item["span"] = row.get("span")
            item["text"] = trunc(row.get("claim"), T1_ITEM_CHARS)
            # GH #67: `foresight` is the statement-level intention marker, and
            # since a speech act may not be a predicate any more it is the only
            # thing left that tells a plan from a fact on a shared axis. Absent
            # for the other two kinds, exactly like the currency marker above, so
            # a world candidate pays no byte of budget for it.
            if str(row.get("fact_kind") or "") == "foresight":
                item["intent"] = "planned"
            # R7 (Nachtrag 3): this candidate's axis lost a version to the
            # audience gate, so no currency may be asserted for it. ONE boolean
            # and nothing else -- not the count, not the instant, not the channel
            # of what was removed, because any of those would rebuild the side
            # channel in a finer grain. What the asker learns is only: I know
            # this, and I cannot vouch that it still holds. That is a statement
            # about this agent's certainty, not about the other room. Absent
            # unless true, so an unaffected candidate costs no byte of budget and
            # renders byte for byte as before.
            if (subject_key(row), axis_key(row)) in unknown_axes:
                item["supersession_unknown"] = True
            item["subject"] = row.get("subject")
            item["predicate"] = row.get("predicate")
            item["valid_from"] = row.get("valid_from")
            item["episode_id"] = row.get("episode_id")
            # #148: a fact knows which session it was said in -- the column is
            # selected, the episode branch keeps it, and this branch used to
            # drop it. Without it a fact cannot be grouped with the turn it came
            # from, and a question that spans sessions has to be answered from a
            # list that no longer knows what a session is.
            item["session_id"] = row.get("session_id")
        else:
            item["text"] = trunc(row.get("content"), T1_ITEM_CHARS)
            item["sender"] = row.get("sender")
            item["session_id"] = row.get("session_id")
            item["happened_at"] = row.get("happened_at")
            item["seen"] = 1
        cost = len(json.dumps(item, sort_keys=True)) // 4 + 1
        # Hard budget cut: the FIRST item that does not fit ends the loop, so the
        # output stays a pure prefix of the ranking.
        if spent + cost > T1_TOKENS:
            break
        if ord_key is not None:
            win_ord[len(candidates)] = ord_key
        candidates.append(item)
        spent += cost
    if window is not None and win_ord:
        # O-2: in window mode the temporal ordering IS the answer (Task 5 / R5),
        # so it binds -- RRF picks the candidates, it does not order them. Only
        # the fact slots are permuted, episodes keep theirs, and the output stays
        # a pure prefix of the ranking. Two passes because the direction differs
        # per component: id ascending, then valid_from/recorded_at descending.
        slots = sorted(win_ord)
        pairs = [(win_ord[i], candidates[i]) for i in slots]
        pairs.sort(key=lambda p: p[0][2])
        pairs.sort(key=lambda p: (p[0][0], p[0][1]), reverse=True)
        for slot, pair in zip(slots, pairs):
            candidates[slot] = pair[1]
    for i, cand in enumerate(candidates):
        cand["rank"] = i + 1
    beliefs = legs.get("beliefs") or []
    bundle = {"query": query, "tier": int(tier), "as_of": as_of,
              "candidates": candidates, "beliefs": beliefs,
              "legs_present": fused.get("legs_present", []),
              "leg_sizes": fused.get("leg_sizes", {}),
              "semantic_degraded": bool(fused.get("semantic_degraded", True)),
              "token_estimate": spent}
    # #88: same verdict, one tier up -- and here it is also RENDERED, because
    # at tier 1 the candidate list itself is what the clamp shaped, and the
    # model reads the text rather than the JSON beside it (same argument as
    # window_ignored at tier 0).
    if query_hygiene is not None:
        bundle["query_hygiene"] = query_hygiene
    if tier == "2" and phase == "t1-emit":
        emit([{"header": {"route": "dialectic", "phase": "dialectic", "recall_id": rid},
               "system": {"instructions": {"text": DIALECTIC_PROMPT}},
               "messages": [{"origin": "user", "type": "text",
                             # #148: `sessions` travels WITH the flat list, not
                             # instead of it. The ranking is still the best
                             # answer to "what is most relevant"; the grouping
                             # is the answer to "what belongs together". A
                             # question that spans sessions needs the second one
                             # and used to get only the first.
                             "text": json.dumps({"question": query, "as_of": as_of,
                                                 "beliefs": beliefs,
                                                 "sessions": sessions_view(candidates),
                                                 "candidates": candidates}, sort_keys=True)}]}])
    lines = ["MEMORY (tier 1, %d candidates, RRF over %s)"
             % (len(candidates), ",".join(bundle["legs_present"]) or "no leg")]
    if query_hygiene is not None:
        lines.append("- query_hygiene: %s (query %d -> %d chars; the legs ran on "
                     "the surviving tail, not on the pasted head)"
                     % (query_hygiene["step"], query_hygiene["from_chars"],
                        query_hygiene["to_chars"]))
    for c in candidates:
        lines.append(render_candidate_line(c))
    header = {"route": "bundle", "recall_id": rid}
    if query_hygiene is not None:
        header["query_hygiene"] = query_hygiene["step"]
    if phase == "t2-downgrade":
        header["tier_downgraded"] = "1"
        bundle["tier_downgraded_from"] = 2
    emit([{"header": header,
           "system": {"memory": {"bundle": {"text": json.dumps(bundle, sort_keys=True)}}},
           "messages": [{"origin": "tool", "type": "tool_result", "id": "recall",
                         "text": "\n".join(lines)}]}])

# ------------------------------------------------------- tier 2: the answer
if phase == "answer":
    finish = str(hop.get("finish_reason", ""))
    body = payload_of(d)
    text = ""
    for m in d.get("messages", []):
        if m.get("text"):
            text = m["text"]
            break
    if finish == "error":
        # Never silence: a provider error downgrades to the tier-1 candidates,
        # which are still parked under this request id.
        emit([scratch_select("t2-downgrade",
                             ["fused", "hyd-fact", "hyd-ep", "hyd-axis", "beliefs"])])
    parsed = body if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if parsed is None:
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(re.sub(r"^```[a-z]*|```$", "", text.strip(), flags=re.M))
        except Exception:
            parsed = None
    gap_missing = False
    if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
        parsed = {"answer": text, "sources": [], "confidence": None}
        gap_missing = True
    gap = str(parsed.get("gap") or "").strip()
    if not gap:
        gap = "unavailable - the model returned no gap statement"
        gap_missing = True
    answer = {"query": query, "tier": 2, "as_of": as_of,
              "answer": str(parsed.get("answer") or ""), "gap": gap,
              "gap_missing": gap_missing,
              "sources": parsed.get("sources") or [],
              "confidence": parsed.get("confidence")}
    header = {"route": "bundle", "recall_id": rid}
    if gap_missing:
        header["gap_missing"] = "1"
    emit([{"header": header,
           "system": {"memory": {"answer": {"text": json.dumps(answer, sort_keys=True)}}},
           "messages": [{"origin": "tool", "type": "tool_result", "id": "recall",
                         "text": "ANSWER: %s\nGAP: %s\nSOURCES: %s"
                                 % (answer["answer"], answer["gap"],
                                    ", ".join(str(s) for s in answer["sources"]))}]}])

park()

tier0_tokens.description: Token budget of the tier-0 bundle (MEMORY_TIER0_TOKENS)

description.purpose: Tier-0 read path: fans three fixed legs (recent episodes of the session, active beliefs of the holder, open foresight facts) at the store, fans them back in through recall_scratch and emits ONE deterministic, token-budgeted bundle. No LLM, no embedding, fixed latency. Since P3 the three legs filter, order and cap IN the store (as-of predicate for foresight), so the script never sees rows it would only drop.
description.use_when: Session boot and cheap ambient context; expose it as a recall tool lane. The caller promotes recall_query/memory_tier from hop to context on the port edge. The SAME edge must promote context.audience_now (a JSON list of participant ids in affinity vocabulary), context.channel and, where the room shows its history to whoever joins, context.channel_open_history='1' — without the first two the request is refused, not answered.
description.not_in_scope: No model in THIS cell: tier 0 is deterministic, tier 1 is an RRF fusion of legs the store computes (`search`, `similar`, `traverse`), and tier 2 asks ./dialectic and folds the answer back in -- the synthesis happens there, never here. Nothing is silently pretended either: a memory_tier this cell does not know, and a provider failure on the tier-2 leg, both DOWNGRADE and say so on hop.tier_downgraded='1'. And no write into the memory: the only table this cell inserts into or updates is its own recall_scratch fan-in.
description.emits_meaning: route rstore: the store ops of the current phase (hop.phase carries the state, hop.recall_id correlates the request; both are promoted to context by the edge). route bundle: the finished bundle — system.memory.bundle.text holds the machine-readable JSON, messages[] a readable tool_result. A tier-1/2 fact candidate of kind `foresight` carries `intent: planned` and renders as "… (planned)": since GH #67 a plan sits on the axis of the matter it is about rather than on a `plans_to_*` axis of its own, so the bundle is the place that has to keep an intention from reading as an accomplished fact. Incomplete fan-ins and lost guard races emit nothing (empty multi-send, terminal). route reject: a caller bug, never a silent default — hop.reject_reason names it ('missing_audience' when the query carries no participant set, 'missing_channel' when it names no room, 'half_open_window' when only one end of a window was given) and the tool_result says it in a sentence. A candidate (tier 1/2) or an open foresight item (tier 0) may carry `supersession_unknown: true` and render as "(currency unknown: cannot vouch that this still holds)": the audience gate removed a version from that axis, so the bundle states what it knows and refuses to assert that it is still in force. The flag is a boolean and carries nothing about what was removed — no count, no instant, no channel.
description.consumes_meaning: A message without a recall phase in context.mem_phase is a fresh request. Store replies are dispatched by (context.mem_phase, hop.operation); hop.rows_affected on the guarded update decides who fires — exactly once per request. The python-side filters and sorts are kept as residual guards behind the store predicates: they are broader than SQL can express (e.g. '' counts as open, not just NULL) and make the migration result-identical by construction. AUDIENCE GATE (#244 / ADR-0002 E11): context.audience_now is the round that is asking, context.channel the room it asks from, context.channel_open_history (default '0') whether that room shows its history to whoever joins. A row with an EMPTY audience_set is refused first, before any other clause is reached (the open-history clause relaxes rows whose provenance is known, it never rescues a row whose provenance is missing). Otherwise a row is visible iff its audience_set contains '*', or the asking round is a SUBSET of it (the rule affinity/brief already decides disclosures with), or the row was recorded in THIS channel and the channel is open — the third clause never crosses a channel boundary, and a row without an audience_set is invisible, not visible. It is applied to candidates, not to rendered output: tier 0 gates each leg before the token budget is spent, tier 1 gates every leg before the RRF sum, so a hidden row can neither take a slot nor move the ranking of a visible one. episodes, facts and entity_edges carry channel + audience_set; a belief carries the set alone (it was derived, not said in a room, so the open-history clause cannot reach it). The semantic leg ranks embeddings, which are untagged, so the audience of the owning facts arrives as its own scratch leg (sem-aud) that the fan-in waits for. R7 (Nachtrag 3), the price of filtering first: the gate drops invisible versions BEFORE the version chain is built, because the other order would let the existence of an invisible version show through a validity span and let a persistent asker map out when something was said in a room they are not in. The price is that a claim whose successor is invisible would look current, so it is not paid silently — the surviving rows of a broken axis are marked in t1-hyd-axis (and in the tier-0 foresight leg), the mark becomes `supersession_unknown` on the candidate, the rendered line says so, and the dialectic prompt forbids presenting such a candidate as what holds now and requires the uncertainty in its gap statement. What the asker learns is only: I know this, and I cannot vouch that it still holds.
examples: {recall_query: 'what does alex drink', tier 0} -> 3 selects -> 3 recall_scratch rows -> guard update (rows_affected 3) -> bundle with beliefs/foresight/episodes
same request twice -> two independent recall_ids -> two byte-identical bundles

{audience_now: ["member:alex","agent:scribe"], channel: 'c1'} asking about something said in c1 before {member:alex, agent:scribe} -> answered; the same question with a third participant present -> the row is not in any leg at all

in_query without context.audience_now -> route reject, hop.reject_reason 'missing_audience'; without context.channel -> 'missing_channel' — never an empty bundle, which a caller cannot tell apart from 'memory knows nothing'

a fact superseded by a version this round may not see -> the bundle answers with the OLDER claim carrying supersession_unknown, not with the newer one and not with silence; the successor's claim, time and channel stay out of the bundle entirely
